in_marathi.name: Smitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Smitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Smitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', meaning Goddess of Wealth. It is also associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, who is revered for her beauty, grace, and abundance.
